profiles.name: offline_container
profiles.filesystem_isolation_expectation: A fresh per-trial container filesystem with only declared fixtures and mounts
profiles.process_isolation_expectation: Agent work executes in the declared container process boundary
profiles.network_expectation: Container egress must be explicitly disabled and verified; Docker use alone is insufficient
profiles.evaluator_network_expectation: Not controlled by the container profile and must be recorded separately
profiles.provider_network_expectation: Not controlled by the container profile
profiles.custom_tool_scorer_boundary: Any code outside the container is outside this isolation guarantee
required_probe: container external DNS and HTTP fail

profiles.name: internal_services_only
profiles.process_isolation_expectation: Declared services run in the isolated trial environment
profiles.network_expectation: Only declared internal service communication; external egress must fail
profiles.evaluator_network_expectation: Recorded separately and not implied by service isolation
profiles.custom_tool_scorer_boundary: Execution location must be recorded for each custom tool and scorer

profiles.name: controlled_mock_access
profiles.filesystem_isolation_expectation: Fresh fixture state for every trial
profiles.process_isolation_expectation: Only the test process and controlled mock are in scope
profiles.network_expectation: Only the declared mock path may be reachable
profiles.evaluator_network_expectation: May remain available but cannot be treated as target evidence unless declared
profiles.provider_network_expectation: Not required for direct component fixtures
profiles.custom_tool_scorer_boundary: Mock calls and scorer inputs must carry explicit target provenance

profiles.name: provider_required
profiles.process_isolation_expectation: Agent execution boundary must be recorded
profiles.network_expectation: Agent tool egress is denied unless explicitly granted
profiles.evaluator_network_expectation: Evaluator connectivity is outside the agent network guarantee
profiles.provider_network_expectation: Model-provider communication is allowed and recorded
profiles.custom_tool_scorer_boundary: Provider-side and evaluator-side execution are separate boundaries

profiles.name: live_external
profiles.filesystem_isolation_expectation: Trial-local artifacts remain separated where possible
profiles.process_isolation_expectation: Execution location is recorded but may be product managed
profiles.network_expectation: Live external connectivity is expected and not deterministic
profiles.custom_tool_scorer_boundary: No network isolation claim without direct evidence
required_probe: failure is classified as product or infrastructure evidence

profiles.name: disposable_worktree
profiles.filesystem_isolation_expectation: Repository working-tree state and trial artifacts are separated by a fresh detached Git worktree and a distinct external artifact directory; host filesystem isolation is not provided
profiles.process_isolation_expectation: NOT_PROVIDED; the Codex and evaluator processes run on the host
profiles.network_expectation: NOT_PROVIDED; a prompt prohibition is not a network control
profiles.provider_network_expectation: Model-provider connectivity is required and is not isolated by the worktree
profiles.custom_tool_scorer_boundary: Inspect and the custom Codex subprocess runner execute on the host; only emitted events and independently captured Git/filesystem outcomes are evidence
required_probe: fresh detached worktree starts at the pinned SHA
per-trial artifacts use a unique directory
start and end Git state are captured
production checkout and main remain unchanged
worktree removal and cross-trial residue are checked
